title: citesync check --format json
description: Output of `citesync check --format json`. A minor release may add rule ids and optional fields; removing or retyping a field bumps `schema_version`, in a major release. A run that couldn't finish (exit 3 or 130) has `errors` and no `summary` or `findings`.

errors.description: Why the run couldn't finish; empty when it did. The text output prints each as a `citesync:` line on stderr.

help.description: What to do about it; null when there is no known next step.

summary.description: Counts after `ignore`. `files` is the number of files checked.

findings.description: Sorted by file, rule and term. Any error makes the exit code 1; info never changes it.

rule.description: A rule id from `citesync rules`; a minor release may add more.

file.description: Relative to the repo root; null for a not-checked field no file holds.

term.description: A CodeMeta term, or @context; null for unreadable, file-missing and manifest-skipped.
